helpers.help.ytdl: 🎬 ***YT-DL MENU COMMANDS*** 1. Send link along with command line: /cmd link -s -opt x:y|x1:y1 2. By replying to link NOTES: Check all yt-dlp api options from this FILE or use this script to convert cli arguments to api options.
helpers.help.quality: 4. Quality Buttons: /cmd link -s Incase default quality added from yt-dlp options using format option and you need to select quality for specific link or links with multi links feature.
helpers.help.options: Options: -opt /cmd link -opt playliststart:^10|fragment_retries:^inf|matchtitle:S13|writesubtitles:true|live_from_start:true|postprocessor_args:{{"ffmpeg": ["-threads", "4"]}}|wait_for_video:(5, 100) Note: Add `^` before integer or float, some values must be numeric and some string. Like playlist_items:10 works with string, so no need to add `^` before the number but playlistend works only with integer so you must add `^` before the number like example above. You can add tuple and dict also. Use double quotes inside dict.
helpers.help.new_name: New Name: 1. /cmd link -n newname 2. By replying to link/file
helpers.help.zip: Zip: 1./cmd link -z 2./cmd link -z password (zip password protected) 3.Reply to a file: /cmd -z /cmd -z password (zip password protected)
helpers.help.multi: Multi by replying to first link/file: /cmd link -i 5 (number of links/files)
helpers.help.same_multi: Multi (with same directory) by replying to first link/file: /cmd link -i 5(number of links/files) -m foldername
helpers.help.direct_link: 1./cmd link 2.Direct link authorization: /cmd link -au username -ap password 3. By replying to link
helpers.help.tg_link_full: Telegram Link Public: https://t.me/channel_name/message_id Private: https://t.me/c/1234567890/message_id Auto-detection: If the bot can't access the link, it automatically falls back to your userbot (requires USER_SESSION_STRING). Upload flags: - -ut → Upload via userbot (premium, 4GB limit) - -bt → Upload via bot (2GB limit, default)
helpers.help.userbot: User Transmission /cmd link -ut (upload via userbot, 4GB for premium) /cmd link -bt (upload via bot, 2GB limit) Note: -ut requires USER_SESSION_STRING and a supergroup. Files >2GB are automatically uploaded via userbot when -ut is used (hybrid leech).
helpers.help.torr_seed: Bittorrent seed: 1. /cmd link -d ratio:seed_time 2. By replying to file/link To specify ratio and seed time add -d ratio:time. Ex: -d 0.7:10 (ratio and time) or -d 0.7 (only ratio) or -d :10 (only time) where time in minutes.
helpers.help.screenshots: Screenshots: /cmd -ss (default values which is 10 photos). You can control this value. Example: /cmd -ss 6.
helpers.help.leech: 📥 ***LEECH MENU COMMANDS*** Send link to leech, /ignore to cancel
helpers.help.clone_help_message: Send Gdrive|Gdot|Filepress|Filebee|Appdrive|Gdflix link along with command or by replying to the link 1. Multi links only by replying to first gdlink link: /clone -i 5(number of links) 2. Gdrive: /clone gdlink/gdrive_id If you want to clone from your token.pickle (uploaded from /usetting) add mtp: before the path/gdrive_id without space. Incase you want to specify whether using token or service accounts you can add tp:link or tp:gdrive_id or sa:link or sa:gdrive_id.
helpers.help.password_error_message: This link requires a password! - Insert :: after the link and write the password after the sign. Example: link::my password
helpers.help.batch:
Send me one of the followings:

helpers.help.url_link: URL links Each link separated by new line Direct link authorization: link username password
helpers.help.txt_file: Txt File Each link inside .txt file separated by new line
helpers.help.upload_dest: Upload Destination: /cmd link -up rcl: (interactive rclone selector) /cmd link -up gd: (interactive gdrive selector) /cmd link -up remote:path (rclone path) /cmd link -up gdrive_id (gdrive folder id)
helpers.help.rclone_flags: Rclone Flags: /cmd link -rcf --buffer-size 256M|--drive-chunk-size 512M Note: Separate flags with |
helpers.help.split_size: Split Size: /cmd link -sp 500m /cmd link -sp 2g Sets custom split size for leech uploads.
helpers.help.name_sub: Name Substitute: /cmd link -ns "old1:new1|old2:new2" Replaces text in filenames before upload.
helpers.help.thumb: Thumbnail: /cmd link -t path/to/thumb.jpg Upload with custom thumbnail.
helpers.help.leech_type: Leech Type: /cmd link -doc (send as document) /cmd link -med (send as media) Overrides default leech mode (document/media).
helpers.help.tg_transmission: Telegram Transmission: /cmd link -ut (upload via user session, 4GB for premium) /cmd link -bt (upload via bot session, 2GB limit) Controls which Telegram session uploads the files.
helpers.help.hybrid_leech: Hybrid Leech: /cmd link -hl Uses bot for files ≤2GB and userbot for files >2GB. Requires premium user session.
helpers.help.force_start: Force Start: /cmd link -f (force start: bypass both download and upload queue) /cmd link -fd (force download only: bypass download queue) /cmd link -fu (force upload only: bypass upload queue)
